patterns.note: Full-bleed hero sections transition into content sections with generous vertical spacing and large typographic elements, creating distinct visual breaks.
A playful, organic display typeface is used for the brand logo and key emotional statements, contrasting with a clean, modern sans-serif for body text and functional headings.
A vibrant, almost neon yellow serves as a primary accent and brand identifier, set against a neutral palette of light beige, black, and a muted teal.
Elements in the hero section (logo, text, background image) parallax at different speeds, creating a layered depth effect as the user scrolls.
A small, initial 'Stay wet' text transforms into a massive, full-screen black 'Stay wet' statement as the user scrolls past the hero, creating a dramatic visual reveal.
The main navigation bar shrinks slightly and gains a solid background color after the initial scroll, becoming sticky at the top of the viewport.
Interstitial full-screen typographic statements ('Stay wet', 'Made for you. Pleasure. your energy.') break up product and feature sections, reinforcing brand messaging with strong visual impact.

technique_notes: The site uses a smooth scrolling library (likely locomotive-scroll) to create a fluid, almost tactile scroll experience, enhancing the perception of depth and movement.

Scroll-triggered animations are used extensively: hero elements parallax at varying speeds, a top banner slides away, and a large typographic statement dramatically reveals and scales into view as the user scrolls down the page.
The main navigation bar transitions from transparent to a solid background and slightly reduces in height, sticking to the top of the viewport after a short scroll distance.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold display headings (~8-10x body) are used for dramatic effect, while body text is a clean, legible sans-serif.
design_tokens.radius: Mostly sharp corners, with subtle rounding on interactive elements like buttons and input fields.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy in hero and full-screen typographic sections, transitioning to a balanced density for product grids and feature lists.

standout: The site's distinctive use of oversized, playful typography that dynamically transforms and animates with scroll, combined with a vibrant yellow accent, creates a highly engaging and memorable brand experience that feels both bold and luxurious.
